runtime_of_training.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

protocol.split: fixed (train raws2,raws3,rawos1,rawos2,rawos4 = 192 frames; val raws1,rawos3 = 75 frames)
protocol.epoch_note: pre-declared fixed epoch, not the argmax checkpoint -- the argmax is itself a random variable and inflates the seed spread

ladder_note: [2026-10-02] The auxiliary ray term is dropped from the paper; the ladder ends at the soft-boundary BCE (C_soft). Metrics are frame-macro IoU_free / IoU_non-free / Precision / Recall / BF@{0.1,0.2,0.3} m.

statistics.rule: two-sided paired t-test over seeds (df = n-1); significant iff the 95% confidence interval of the mean paired difference excludes 0
statistics.multiple_comparisons: each metric tested separately, no correction
statistics.sigma_run: data/rerun_noise_c_soft_vs_overall_control.csv -- C_soft and the 01_overall fixed-split control share every setting and seed; sigma_run = sd(diff)/sqrt(2)

claims: see REPORT.md (written from this campaign's data)
